basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: Represents the customer, supplier and partner roles of one party without duplicating the party record.
Holds references to contact endpoints rather than copies of their values.
Separates the commercial relationship from the legal identity of the counterparty.

may: Run profile validation on counterparty roles.
Read which roles a party holds and in which scope.
mustNot: Create a second party identity for a party that already exists upstream.
Copy contact values into the relationship record.
Change the upstream party or CRM master while validating.
requiresHuman: Starting or ending a relationship with a counterparty.
Resolving which upstream record is the master when two disagree.

considerations: Contact details of people at counterparties are personal data and must stay minimal and purpose-bound.
Role labels such as blocked supplier affect livelihoods and need evidence and review.
affectedParties: Contact persons at customers, suppliers and partners

owners.steward: The commercial operations owner stewards counterparty roles; party identity stays with the party master.

items: Party reference to the upstream master record.
Role and scope identifiers local to the Company Dimension.

properties.reason: Institutional or informational subject: it has no physical body to measure.

items: A counterparty role names one party, a role type (customer, supplier, partner) and a scope.
Duplicate counterparties that split history and limits.
Stale roles that keep blocked or ended partners active.
GLEIF LEI for legal entity identification.
Party models in CRM and ERP systems.
Sales, procurement and partner management inside one company or group.

sections.whatItIs: A companion profile for a Company Dimension that represents the commercial roles one party plays towards the company, as customer, supplier or partner, in a stated scope, while party identity and contact values stay in their own masters.

sources.title: Research record EM-COM-01: independent provider studies, audits and reconciled findings
sources.note: Evidence behind the release; claims in the card trace to it.
